children.name: Evidence
children.value: The blocks hold a new config block, which libwavpack has written since 5.0; libwavpack reports encoder version 5 for a file with one

findings.message: The first block says the file holds 24000 samples, but its audio blocks hold 17512.
The data ends inside the header of a block at 0x6010: 10 of its 32 bytes are there.
